text: Real photograph wired into hero.astro (public/PORTRAIT.jpg), replacing the text placeholder.

Real writing pipeline is built (Astro content collection at src/content/writing/, /writing index page, /writing/[slug] post pages, homepage teaser and nav link both wired to appear automatically once posts exist). Still needs actual posts — nothing renders until at least one .md file lands in src/content/writing/.
Contact email is jerry@lockard.tech, confirmed live by Jerry 2026-08-19, wired into footer.astro via data/site.ts.
GitHub handle confirmed: jerry-lockard. jerrylockard91 is an old unused account — never use it. Wired into footer.astro.
LinkedIn wired into footer.astro: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jerrylockard/ (slug is jerrylockard, no hyphen — differs from the GitHub handle's hyphenation, identity.json corrected to match).

Footer has a conditional résumé link (src/components/footer.astro) that only renders once public/resume.pdf exists on disk. Self-hosted by design — no Google Docs/Drive. Jerry needs to drop the actual PDF at public/resume.pdf and commit it; link appears automatically on next build once it's there.
Theme choice persists across reloads — real localStorage read/write wired into layout.astro's setTheme().
Fonts currently load from the Google Fonts CDN. Self-host the WOFF2 files for the Pi deploy — removes a third-party dependency and a render-blocking request.
